excerpt: Pure-Omega, Zero-CUDA, DNA-Chained LLM Training, Specialist & Serving Engine on Raw Blackwell Silicon. Omega Helix (ollm / ollm-gb10) is an entire end-to-end language model stack BPE tokenizer, transformer pretraining, BF16 Tensor-Core & FP32 SM121 Blackwell GPU kernels, DNA-style Merkle Specialist Chains (OLLMSP01 + spclip), Looped-Core & Adaptive Neuralese (OLLMCK03 + LTP0), KV-cached sampling, and an OpenAI-compatible HTTP server compiled into a single static binary with zero CUDA, zero cuBLAS, zero PyTorch, zero C, and zero libc. Repo Scope & Language Disclosure: omega-helix is the standalone pure-Omega LLM training, DNA specialist, and serving engine; omega-mv (seed/helix/) holds the bootstrapped omc compiler and proof-carrying toolchain. All engine binaries, GPU kernels, tokenizers, and HTTP servers in native/ are 100% pure Omega (.om) with zero Python or C; Python files under tests/ and tools/ are strictly the independent f64 referee oracle (oracle.py) and optional local Studio UI/CLI helpers (marked linguist-vendored in .gitattributes). Driver & Firmware Disclosure: "Zero CUDA" means zero NVIDIA userspace libraries or CUDA toolkit (ldd: not a dynamic executable). GPU execution opens /dev/nvidiactl, /dev/nvidia0, and /dev/nvidia-uvm directly via raw Linux ioctl calls through the open Linux kernel modules (nvidia / nvidia-uvm) and NVIDIA's signed GSP firmware. Runs cleanly on any Apple Silicon Mac or Linux (x86_64 / aarch64) machine with Python 3 + omc — compiles the static engine, verifies linkage (otool -L / ldd), checks bit-exact gradient/step parity against the independent Python f64 oracle, and trips two live negative controls (rc=61 on tampered .sp, non-zero on injected oracle mutant): git clone && cd omega-helix sh scripts/verify-30s.sh Recorded unedited on DGX Spark GB10 (evidence/proof-zero-cuda-gb10/{transcript.txt, proof.cast} via scripts/record-zero-cuda-proof.sh): Matched model (V=4096, T=256, D=384, H=12, F=1536, L=8, B=64, 15,833,472 params…
